Qwen 3.8 Max now available on Vercel AI Gateway
Call Alibaba's Qwen 3.8 Max through Vercel AI Gateway with one API key: no provider account, automatic fallbacks, spend tracking, and traces on every request.
Walter Korman, Jerilyn Zheng
AI Gateway now supports team and project spend budgets
Cap spend for a whole team or a single project, with email alerts and default budgets that new projects and keys inherit automatically.Jeremy Philemon, Walter Korman, and 2 othersDeepSeek V4 Flash now runs updated weights on AI Gateway
DeepSeek V4 Flash now runs on updated weights on AI Gateway, served by DeepSeek by default, with stronger agentic capabilities.Jerilyn ZhengProduct, AI GatewayChat SDK now supports reactions and ephemeral messages on Teams
Chat SDK's Microsoft Teams adapter now supports message reactions and native ephemeral messages, plus author emails via Microsoft Graph and custom token factories.Ben SabicContent EngineerAI Gateway logs now have a dedicated page
Inspect every request's cost, token counts, duration, and fallback path across providers, with filters you can share by URL.Sam Chitgopekar, Jerilyn ZhengVercel MCP now supports the <date> MCP specification
Vercel MCP now supports the <date> MCP specification, with a stateless protocol core and hardened authorization. Existing clients need no changes.Josh SouphanthongSoftware EngineerExpanded search for workflow runs in Vercel Observability
Filter runs by workflow, environment, deployment ID, region, or custom attributes, with typeahead suggestions and shareable queries.Karthik Kalyanaraman, Mitul Shah10x more capacity for Laguna S 2.1 on AI Gateway
Laguna S 2.1 from Poolside now has higher usage limits on AI Gateway, on both the paid and free versions, so you can run higher-volume agentic coding and long-running tasks.Rohan Taneja, Jerilyn Zheng
